Private Investigator

The first question was whether the object could be polished until it looked new. The conservator took a long sip of water before beginning again.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_1e6708cc4248f5cb88e6: A plant beside the accounts department has survived another reorganisation while remaining in the same pot. Employees admire its stable responsibilities and access to natural light. Nobody has yet asked it to justify its position.

systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_416aeb6ec2935b57f5d9: Members of a newly formed neighbourhood watch spent an evening observing the street behind their meeting hall. Organisers praised the excellent visibility before learning that none of them lived there. The watched residents reported feeling safer, if slightly judged.

systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_9d4b3bb80df657903c92: An office's new fax machine produced its first document within minutes of installation: six pages intended for a dental supplier. Employees admired the speed before realising the machine had simply made being interrupted more expensive. The teeth remain unaccounted for.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_9da63ea3bc0d3d9163ff: A customer using a newly purchased magnifying glass discovered several previously overlooked conditions in its guarantee. The shop maintains that this demonstrates the product's effectiveness. The customer agrees, although not in the spirit originally intended.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_9f2a349feae5b3c2ee1d: A hotel guest studying the evacuation diagram has developed a more detailed understanding of the building than several members of staff. The guest also located the breakfast room. Reception considers both discoveries useful, though one is considerably more popular.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_9fe5e553f912f32a2a8a: A customer has carefully retained a receipt for a deeply impractical household ornament. The document establishes the price and date but offers no explanation for the decision. Family members have requested supplementary evidence.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_a1c320bc95f7f4310002: Department Orders Rubber Stamp to Confirm Rubber Stamp Orders
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_a54ed25b1237dbc65e5d: A dinner guest who politely offered assistance was handed a sack of potatoes and a peeler. Witnesses described a brief silence as the guest reconsidered the social contract. The host has been criticised for taking hospitality's least sincere sentence literally.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_a7f911ee2c1f5c037210: Man Buys Organiser, Schedules Time to Find It
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_a8ad90191c10d60637cc: A pedestrian attempting to save five minutes arrived twenty minutes late with a much richer understanding of the district. He described the route as educational. His companion suggested that next time they could learn something while walking in the correct direction.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ab3897f7f74f1097d268: Guest Reads Emergency Exit Plan, Becomes Most Prepared Person on Floor
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_abfbcbcffd221c30f1ed: A laboratory has labelled an unidentified sample 'unidentified sample' following a review of storage procedures. Staff say the change makes its status considerably clearer. Determining what the sample actually contains remains a separate project requiring a different form.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ad4232654a2458c67ab4: Hotel Pillow Menu Creates Unexpected Decision
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ad72fbbbb4e1bcc7703f: A participant in a harmless dispute about a borrowed lawnmower recalled the weather, the neighbour's shoes and a passing delivery van. The actual agreement remains unclear. Both parties have been advised to write things down next time, preferably on the same piece of paper.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_adbed2b24b8edef53a24: A clothing shop has introduced a coat with enough compartments for notebooks, gloves and several conflicting theories. A visiting investigator praised its capacity but asked whether any of the pockets contained work. The salesman offered a matching hat.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_af896887b9c0c4036f95: Office Printer Demands Paper Already Visible in Tray
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b0852601c4b7be118519: A glove recovered from a public bench has been paired with another glove from the lost-property drawer. Staff acknowledge that the colours, sizes and hands do not match. They nevertheless describe the arrangement as better than being alone.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b2aa7ac35be9ecb94d05: Lost Glove Reunited With Wrong Glove
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b32d7f3f8a03e335a8a0: Visitors following an audio guide heard a detailed account of a bronze ceremonial vessel while looking at a wooden chair. Several praised the interpretation before a member of staff noticed. The chair has since received more attention than any of the vessels.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b356e0221ba06adb7241: Dinner Guest Offers to Help, Given Actual Task
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b7f2123ea9b422beb957: A dog has selected one particular stick from a park containing many objectively similar sticks. Its owner offered a straighter specimen and was met with visible disappointment. The original stick has now been brought home for reasons that remain entirely clear to the dog.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_b8fcd4e7f21d9293d070: A traveller brought clothing for rain, sunshine, formal dining and an unspecified outdoor emergency. The resulting suitcase required assistance on the first staircase. The owner says the packing was successful apart from the transport aspect.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_be61d7800b02417d2408: Auctioneer Describes Ugly Vase as an Acquired Taste
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_bfeeb88019a7e707173a: A visitor unfolded a city map and immediately lost sight of both the street and their travelling companion. Passers-by offered directions to the visible corners. The visitor eventually found the correct square but could no longer fold the evidence.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_c30705b19e972176c335: After repeated failures to wake its owner, an alarm clock has been relocated beyond arm's reach. The owner described the move as a firm but fair management decision. By morning, both owner and clock had returned to the bedside table.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_c36549442f06865baa87: Detective Coat Has More Pockets Than Current Leads
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_c4ab182e5aeabea2946b: Employees have proposed relocating a suggestion box away from the manager's office window. Management welcomed the engagement but requested that future suggestions include names. The box has since enjoyed a period of peaceful inactivity.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_caebd261a777e1e543ed: Mystery Club Solves Refreshment Problem Before Mystery
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_cd7cee49e30315a44e6b: A historical society has postponed its anniversary dinner while members investigate when the society began. Minutes from the earliest meeting refer to an earlier meeting. The caterer has requested a date that belongs to the future.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_cffb741f845a2ea47553: Resident Returns Borrowed Ladder, Friendship Enters Uncharted Territory
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d2cde02cade16490b9a4: A private investigator searching an untidy office found an invoice previously believed lost. The client welcomed its return but clarified that the assignment concerned something else. The investigator says a discovery remains a discovery, particularly when it can be attached to a bill.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d3400677ecc393c41b02: A museum shop has expanded its range of miniature exhibits, allowing visitors to take home a manageable amount of history. The curator noted that the originals require careful conservation. The shop manager noted that the miniatures require only a shelf and a willingness to dust.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d371b4d36c3726fe9a03: An employee satisfaction survey identified its own length as a leading source of dissatisfaction. Management will investigate the finding through a follow-up questionnaire. Staff have asked whether the original answer might be forwarded instead.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d6020fbc9546b5943b6a: Concertgoers received a programme listing an entirely different performance. An inserted apology corrected the date but not the musicians. The audience applauded enthusiastically at the end, possibly relieved to recognise something on schedule.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d634a07691ea20a1cd34: Man Recognises Acquaintance Just Too Late to Wave Naturally
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_d95b098056b1690590fc: Guest Compliments Chair, Host Explains Entire Purchasing History
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_dc470f59dc244c7f991b: A theatre manager has defended the interval as an essential part of the dramatic experience. Audience members used it to exchange confident interpretations of characters who had not yet appeared. One patron blamed the lighting for what later proved to be the plot.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ddb3c9af50fb4b436449: A plain brown suitcase attracted the attention of several travellers before its actual owner arrived. Each temporary claimant recognised a small detail proving it belonged to someone else. The owner has promised to attach a ribbon before the next journey.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e025f9f9bbf73d0754ad: Office Plant Survives Restructuring Without Change of Title
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e06d9ea56a61143d1665: A mystery-reading club spent its latest meeting establishing who had brought the good biscuits. The culprit confessed readily and was thanked. Discussion of the selected novel has been postponed until members finish investigating the second tin.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e157e539879152e1758e: A ladder lent out several years ago has returned to its owner in good condition. Both neighbours stood beside it, unsure what to discuss now. They eventually agreed that the weather had been unusual and that one of them might need a drill.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e173bd6f43a4b1ce4547: Company Survey Finds Staff Would Prefer Shorter Survey
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e281400387581018b70f: An office has replaced alphabetical filing with a colour-coded system. Staff agree that missing documents now look much more organised. A guide explaining the colours has been filed somewhere under the previous system.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e2f43eb5d04c77396b45: Man Takes Shortcut, Discovers Several New Streets
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e3116050d1a2e78ded20: A returned library book contained a shopping list, a train timetable and a handwritten plan to change careers. All were marking page seven. Staff have placed the papers in lost property and wish the reader well with whichever task comes first.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_e81d8652841467e1a8ef: Gallery Visitor Studies Fire Instructions for Twelve Minutes
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ea06ec112c6d793ef321: Office Changes Filing System, Reclassifies Confusion
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ed926a45742c436658c1: A resident has confirmed that the biscuits in her best tin are reserved for visitors. The tin has remained untouched through three birthdays and a plumbing emergency. Asked whether she might eat one herself, she said she was not that sort of guest.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_ee07d03bd09d07242639: Queue Continues After Everyone Forgets What It Is For
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_f21c429ffbf5d80edea1: Passengers waiting for a delayed train were informed that refreshments remained available. The announcement was technically accurate but received without enthusiasm. One customer said the sandwich had clearly been waiting longer than they had.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_f3b016a993dc35342a07: Laboratory Labels Mystery Sample, Solves Administrative Part of Mystery
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_f5a65ff4ce13b63a3fb9: Restoration Expert Asked Whether Old Thing Could Look Newer
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_f77153aee9eee6dd471e: A small gallery has corrected the label beneath a portrait after archival research established that it depicts a different member of the same family. Visitors have accepted the change calmly. The expression in the portrait remains deeply unimpressed.
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_f81d3d743fbf0d583886: Concert Programme Apologises for Printing Last Year’s Programme
systems/newsstand/SharedNewspaperArticle.t_fe1d329b95deefae6540: Witness Remembers Everything Except Subject of Conversation

tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_020d9feb00ebd493aefa: The files are open. Time to see whose story survives the evidence.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_08808396627e86370fee: Answer the Crime Lab call and hear the reconstruction.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_0a3caf483cfc74688dd5: The lab found something useful. Naturally, they will explain it over the phone.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_1410fe6ad886c6b5a654: Witness accounts collected. Trust issues unlocked.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_221981bb683cb28f7f1c: Nobody home. How considerate of them to leave the evidence.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_2421a1de44fae81f518d: Search the apartment and collect the escape evidence.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_2ad59f46625fcb9fbb93: Next stop: the Crime Lab. Your ticket needs a second opinion.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_330f6b7bee175fcfb9dc: Use the lab result to choose your next city. The thief has a head start. Do not give them a sightseeing allowance.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_396f8165e6c7ddf84c1d: Search the crime scene and find the hidden objects.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_3bbb247a90f205e3e3f7: Use the forensic clues and the reconstruction to narrow down your suspects. You decide who does not fit.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_40cfca41c403bc9f9e39: Now you know what kind of thief you are looking for.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_59f7beb50ca0cc785a4c: Open the Evidence Grid to compare the suspects with the evidence.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_5eef2ab87dde0030dbd5: Two suspects remain. Click SEND TO ALIBIS.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_5fdde590ece0cae81bf5: Inspect the objects and collect useful items. Keep the ticket: the Crime Lab can examine it. Then return to Crime City.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_66bd164ab6e236a20147: Shortlist sent. Return to Crime City.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_698b9cf384ad2ceab4fb: Every object matters until you know how the crime happened. Free hint: slow and safe. Legal hint: costs money. Illegal hint: HQ will pretend it never saw it.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_6cea0271c6fe2903439d: Combine the forensic clues with the skills needed for the theft. Click SEND TO ALIBIS to submit your shortlist, then return to Crime City.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_7eabc10201d8278c339b: Go to the Crime Lab and collect the forensic result.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_85ad93eafb3dae20fee4: Place the elements in the slots. The system tells you what fits, what almost fits, and what is nonsense. Three tries, then it costs points.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_8adc6da1cbd1d17bfe7b: For this first case, the lab has already analysed the evidence. Later, you will have to do it yourself.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_90300513a4af31cd8386: Check the stories against each other. Someone is covering for a suspect. Their confidence is not supporting evidence.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_97f30e451538697cf614: Use the remaining clues to narrow your shortlist to two people.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_9822c06f13c76e6c47ec: Return to the Crime Lab and have the ticket examined.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_9ad172ebdf017a4d7bfa: Ask the lab to examine the ticket from your inventory. A damaged destination is still a destination. Just less cooperative.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_9c10d0671b6ea5f480ba: Destination clue recovered. Time to put the travel budget in danger.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_a08ad7534081cb98400f: Use the glowing button at the bottom right to submit your shortlist. Then return to Crime City.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_a42b435fc930122264b7: Ask about the remaining suspects and where they were during the theft. Everybody has an alibi. Some of them are even true.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_a500a7ac6e4c61b384bc: The false alibi gives you your next lead. You still need more information before issuing an arrest warrant.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_b1f6dfad514e777ebc84: Compare the testimonies with the timeline and expose the false alibi.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_c3b96318a759db560542: Talk to the witnesses and collect their accounts.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_cc91b09ffcb426913432: Lots of objects, zero context. Perfect. That is what the lab is for.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_cdb8bfbdf4711d519710: Now you know what skills the thief needed.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_d7b758117e35738dd7ea: Click the glowing CRIME CITY button at the bottom left. Next, we will check the witnesses and their alibis.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_e76bc9ed34c1b358fd42: Open Travel in the bottom menu and follow the destination clue.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_e9fbc37b2cdf6615f604: The report explains how the theft was carried out. Listen carefully: the method will matter later.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_ed1a7a1b1769d3de48c1: Two suspects remain. Evidence got us this far. Now we need their stories.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_f1be86cd9cc389a7c0a5: Tutorial complete. Follow the trail, detective.
tutorials/CrimeCityTutorial.js.t_f3fa4dbfee624492c90f: The alibi has collapsed. Time to visit the apartment.

tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_1bc207dc3469bc702f81: Storage first, detective. Alex has your welcome package. It is mostly paperwork.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_34727d35407404146859: Explore freely, detective. Your next objective is still waiting.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_3527ede660ed8af1602d: Excellent. You have located a cabinet. Promotion is surely inevitable.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_51066ebb52a4d63d6ff7: The globe is the agency travel desk, because apparently airports were too expensive.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_56618ea3d9ff32c463b6: Good. Now let us inconvenience an international airport.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_58cc87232276fe1dba75: Click STORAGE on the left. Alex Murphy handles equipment, manuals, and unreasonable requests.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_a741e176edb04fc4e53d: Walk over to the case-file cabinet.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_b92c43ef3c5596815322: Click the cabinet when you are close enough. Bureaucracy has never been this dangerous.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_c228ea482a9b3b96226b: Open the case file in the cabinet.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_c522b89272a16a0d3d2f: Use the movement controls and approach the cabinet marked by the glowing frame.

tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_e1500fb30b7f748fc53b: Choose the destination and begin the investigation before the trail gets cold.
tutorials/FirstCaseTutorial.js.t_f2ef23a76c4f1c999d87: A stolen artefact, four days, and no mention of health insurance.

ui/WorldPoliceReactionHooks.js.t_1f88c861616c3e014507: The public report says the pursuit ended without a detention. That is all I can discuss from that bulletin.
ui/WorldPoliceReactionHooks.js.t_250f08e55f61a99fdd93: The public update describes an unresolved inquiry. Filing the outcome is not the same as solving the case. Our cabinets know the difference.
ui/WorldPoliceReactionHooks.js.t_2610009c4e9f29fc7fbf: The bulletin reports a detention. A verdict is a separate matter. We have separate forms. Naturally.
ui/WorldPoliceReactionHooks.js.t_cb5bb3ca960096f179b7: The defendant was released. The public report does not establish a conviction. Please resist the urge to improve the wording.

ui/WorldPostOfficeReactionHooks.js.t_2077680384edeef17c0d: The defendant was released, according to the bulletin. I don’t add “guilty” in the margin just because somebody at the counter prefers it.

ui/WorldPostOfficeReactionHooks.js.t_5c1c3ff8d9d9505a6b5c: Detained is not convicted. We prefer our labels precise. It saves a great deal of arguing at the counter.

ui/WorldPostOfficeReactionHooks.js.t_ce3fa80bd4ad82288b48: The court reached a verdict. Good. One less public argument to overhear while I’m trying to count stamps.
